project_summary: Mobile banking API with OAuth 2.0 authentication and PSD2 compliance

components.name: OAuth 2.0 authentication backend
components.description: Implementation of OAuth 2.0 flows (authorization code, refresh token) with JWT-based session management, multi-tenant token isolation, and rate limiting per client.

components.name: PSD2 open banking connectors
components.description: Integration with the account information (AIS) and payment initiation (PIS) APIs of three Spanish banks, including consent management, strong customer authentication redirects and certificate rotation.

components.name: Accounts and transactions API
components.description: REST endpoints for account balances, transaction history with pagination and filtering, and CSV export, backed by a read model refreshed from the banking connectors.

components.name: Push and email notifications
components.description: Transactional notifications for payments, low balance and security events through Firebase Cloud Messaging and SendGrid, with user preferences and quiet hours.

components.name: Observability and audit log
components.description: Structured logging, request tracing and an immutable audit trail of every money movement and consent change, with a 7-year retention policy required by the regulator.

project_summary: Consumer loan origination platform with automated credit scoring and e-signature

components.name: Applicant onboarding and KYC
components.description: Multi-step web onboarding with identity document capture, liveness check through a third-party KYC provider and sanctions list screening before a loan application can be submitted.

components.name: Credit scoring engine
components.description: Rule-based scoring combined with a logistic regression model over bureau data and bank statements, exposing a decision endpoint with explainability fields for each rejected application.

components.name: Contract generation and e-signature
components.description: PDF loan contract generation from templates with the approved conditions and a qualified electronic signature flow integrated with a European trust service provider.

components.name: Disbursement and repayment schedule
components.description: SEPA credit transfer for disbursement, amortisation schedule calculation, direct debit collection of instalments and dunning workflow for late payments.

components.name: Back-office portal
components.description: Internal web app for credit analysts to review applications, override scores with a justification, and monitor the loan portfolio with basic dashboards.

project_summary: Payment gateway with card tokenisation, 3-D Secure and merchant dashboard

components.name: Card tokenisation vault
components.description: PCI DSS scoped service that stores card data encrypted with HSM-backed keys and exposes tokens to the rest of the platform, with key rotation and detokenisation audit.

components.name: 3-D Secure 2 authentication flow
components.description: Integration with the card schemes' 3DS2 directory servers, challenge and frictionless flows, and fallback handling when the issuer ACS is unavailable.

components.name: Acquirer routing and settlement
components.description: Routing of authorisations to two acquiring banks by BIN and cost, retry on soft declines, daily settlement file reconciliation and chargeback intake.

components.name: Merchant dashboard
components.description: Web dashboard for merchants with transaction search, refunds, payout calendar and API key management, including role-based access for merchant staff.

components.name: Webhooks and merchant SDK
components.description: Signed webhook delivery with retries and a small JavaScript SDK for hosted payment fields so merchants never touch raw card data.

project_summary: Robo-advisor web app with portfolio rebalancing and regulatory suitability test

components.name: MiFID II suitability questionnaire
components.description: Configurable questionnaire that profiles the investor's risk tolerance and knowledge, stores versioned answers and blocks investment until a valid profile exists.

components.name: Model portfolios and rebalancing engine
components.description: Definition of five model portfolios of ETFs, drift detection against target weights and generation of rebalancing orders with tax-lot awareness.

components.name: Broker order routing
components.description: Integration with the custodian broker API to place, cancel and reconcile orders, including end-of-day position reconciliation and discrepancy alerts.

components.name: Investor web app
components.description: Responsive single-page app showing portfolio performance, contributions, documents and the rebalancing history, with onboarding funnel analytics.

project_summary: Headless fashion e-commerce storefront with product catalog search and Stripe checkout

components.name: Product catalog service
components.description: Product, variant and inventory model with sizes and colours, bulk import from the ERP, image processing pipeline and a public read API with caching.

components.name: Catalog search and filtering
components.description: Full-text search with typo tolerance, faceted filtering by category, size, colour and price, and merchandising rules to pin or boost products.

components.name: Cart and Stripe checkout
components.description: Persistent cart for guests and logged-in users, promo codes, shipping rate calculation and Stripe Checkout with Apple Pay and Bizum, including webhook-driven order confirmation.

components.name: Storefront UI
components.description: Server-rendered storefront with product listing, product detail, lookbook pages and SEO metadata, built on a shared design system with Lighthouse performance targets.

components.name: Order management and returns
components.description: Order lifecycle (paid, fulfilled, shipped, delivered), carrier label generation and a self-service returns flow with refund through Stripe.

project_summary: B2B marketplace for hardware suppliers with tiered pricing, quotes and ERP integration

components.name: Vendor onboarding and catalog upload
components.description: Vendor accounts with company verification, CSV and Excel catalog upload with validation reports, and approval workflow before products go live.

components.name: Tiered pricing and customer groups
components.description: Price lists per customer group, volume discounts, negotiated prices per account and VAT handling for intra-community sales.

components.name: Request-for-quote workflow
components.description: Buyers request quotes for large orders, vendors respond with offers and expiry dates, and accepted quotes convert into orders with the agreed prices.

components.name: ERP integration (SAP Business One)
components.description: Bidirectional synchronisation of customers, stock and invoices with SAP Business One through its Service Layer, with retry queues and a reconciliation report.

components.name: Shipping and pallet logistics
components.description: Shipping cost calculation by weight, volume and pallet count, integration with two carriers for labels and tracking, and delivery slot selection at checkout.

project_summary: Online bakery shop with next-day delivery slots, subscriptions and WooCommerce migration

components.name: WooCommerce migration and catalog
components.description: Migration of 180 products and 4.000 customers from a legacy Prestashop into WooCommerce, with URL redirects and a custom product type for daily-baked goods.

components.name: Delivery slots and 48-hour lead time
components.description: Checkout step that offers delivery windows by postal code with capacity limits per slot and enforces a minimum 48-hour lead time for custom cakes.

components.name: Bread subscriptions
components.description: Weekly and biweekly subscriptions with pause and skip, recurring payments through Stripe and Bizum, and automatic production list for the bakery each morning.

components.name: Bilingual storefront (Spanish and Catalan)
components.description: Translation of catalog, checkout and transactional emails into Catalan with language switch and localised URLs, keeping a single order database.

components.name: Sales export to Excel
components.description: Daily and monthly sales, product and delivery-route reports exported to Excel for the accountant, scheduled by email.

project_summary: Mobile shopping app for a home and garden retailer with loyalty points and store pickup

components.name: Cross-platform mobile app shell
components.description: React Native app for iOS and Android with navigation, offline product browsing cache, push notifications and crash reporting, published to both stores.

components.name: Customer login and social sign-in
components.description: Email, Google and Apple sign-in with secure token storage, account merge for existing web customers and passwordless magic-link recovery.

components.name: Loyalty points and coupons
components.description: Points accrual on purchases, tiers with benefits, coupon redemption at checkout and a monthly expiry job, exposed through a rules-driven service.

components.name: Buy online, pick up in store
components.description: Store selector with real-time stock per store, pickup time reservation, QR code for collection and staff app screen to mark orders as handed over.

components.name: In-app payments
components.description: Card payments with Conekta and OXXO cash vouchers, saved cards per customer and refund handling for cancelled pickups.

project_summary: Appointment booking and patient portal for a dental clinic network with reminders

components.name: Online appointment booking
components.description: Availability engine per dentist, chair and treatment duration, with double-booking prevention, waiting list and rescheduling from a public booking page.

components.name: SMS and WhatsApp reminders
components.description: Automated reminders 48 and 2 hours before each visit with confirm or cancel replies, through Twilio, and a no-show report per clinic.

components.name: Patient portal
components.description: Patients log in to see upcoming visits, treatment plans, invoices and radiographs, with document download and consent form signature.

components.name: Clinical records integration
components.description: Read-only synchronisation of treatment plans and visit history from the clinic management software through its HL7 FHIR export, mapped to the portal model.

project_summary: Telemedicine platform with video consultations, e-prescriptions and GDPR-compliant medical records

components.name: Video consultation module
components.description: WebRTC video rooms with waiting room, screen sharing of test results, connection quality fallback to audio and consultation recording with explicit patient consent.

components.name: Electronic health record
components.description: Structured medical record with encounters, diagnoses coded in ICD-10, allergies and medication list, field-level encryption and full access audit trail.

components.name: Electronic prescriptions
components.description: Prescription drafting with drug interaction warnings, digital signature by the physician and transmission to the national e-prescription service.

components.name: Physician scheduling and billing
components.description: Physician availability calendar, patient booking, insurance coverage check and invoicing with automatic reimbursement claims.

components.name: GDPR consent and data subject rights
components.description: Consent management per processing purpose, data export in machine-readable format, right-to-erasure workflow with legal retention exceptions and a DPO audit console.

project_summary: Laboratory results portal and HL7 integration with analyser instruments

components.name: Analyser interface (HL7 v2 and ASTM)
components.description: Listener services that receive results from five laboratory analysers over HL7 v2 and ASTM, normalise units and reference ranges and flag abnormal values.

components.name: Result validation workflow
components.description: Two-step validation by technician and pathologist with delta checks against previous results, comments and automatic release of normal panels.

components.name: Patient and physician results portal
components.description: Secure portal where patients download PDF reports and physicians see cumulative result charts, with SMS notification when a report is released.

components.name: Insurance billing export
components.description: Monthly billing files per insurer with the tests performed, price lists and rejected-claim handling, exported in the formats each insurer requires.

project_summary: Manufacturing execution system (MES) for a steel plant with shop-floor data capture and OEE dashboards

components.name: Shop-floor data acquisition
components.description: OPC UA and Modbus TCP collectors for 40 machines capturing counters, states and alarms every second into a time-series store, with buffering during network outages and a device health monitor. The collectors run on edge gateways in each production line, support hot configuration reload when a new machine is commissioned, expose Prometheus metrics for the IT team, and include a replay tool to re-ingest buffered data after an outage so that the OEE calculations downstream remain complete; the plant operates 24/7 in three shifts and any gap in the data invalidates the shift report, which is why this component carries most of the integration risk of the project.

components.name: Work order execution
components.description: Download of production orders from SAP, operator terminal to start, pause and complete operations, material consumption and traceability of heats and coils.

components.name: Quality inspections and non-conformities
components.description: Inspection plans per product, sampling results capture with tolerances, non-conformity reports with photos and blocking of affected lots.

components.name: OEE and downtime dashboards
components.description: Availability, performance and quality calculation per machine and shift, downtime reason coding by operators and Grafana dashboards for plant managers.

components.name: Maintenance requests
components.description: Operators raise maintenance requests from the terminal, maintenance team schedules interventions, and the system links downtime events to work done.

components.name: SAP PP confirmations
components.description: Posting of production confirmations, scrap and goods movements back to SAP PP through IDocs with error queue and manual reprocessing screen.

project_summary: IoT predictive maintenance platform for industrial refrigeration units

components.name: Telemetry ingestion
components.description: MQTT broker and Go ingestion service receiving temperature, pressure and compressor cycles from 2.000 units, with schema validation, deduplication and storage in a time-series database.

components.name: Anomaly detection and failure prediction
components.description: Feature pipeline over telemetry windows and a gradient boosting model predicting compressor failure within 14 days, retrained weekly with technician feedback labels.

components.name: Alerting and technician dispatch
components.description: Alert rules combining thresholds and model scores, escalation policies, and automatic creation of service tickets assigned to the nearest technician.

components.name: Fleet dashboard
components.description: Map and list view of all units with live status, health score history per unit, filters by customer and site, and export of maintenance history.

components.name: Firmware over-the-air updates
components.description: Staged firmware rollout to gateways with signed packages, rollback on failed health check and progress reporting per batch.

project_summary: Warehouse and inventory management for a packaging manufacturer with barcode scanning

components.name: Inventory and locations model
components.description: Multi-warehouse stock with bins, lots and expiry dates, stock movements ledger and cycle counting with variance approval.

components.name: Barcode scanning PWA
components.description: Progressive web app for rugged Android scanners covering receiving, put-away, picking and shipping, working offline and syncing when connectivity returns.

components.name: Replenishment and purchase suggestions
components.description: Minimum and maximum stock rules per item, consumption forecasting from the last twelve months and purchase order suggestions grouped by supplier.

components.name: GS1 label printing
components.description: Generation of GS1-128 pallet and case labels with serial shipping container codes, printed on Zebra printers from the scanning app.

components.name: Stock reporting
components.description: Stock valuation, ageing and turnover reports with Excel export and a nightly snapshot for the finance team.

project_summary: Last-mile delivery platform with route optimisation, driver app and customer tracking

components.name: Route optimisation engine
components.description: Daily route planning for 120 vehicles using a vehicle routing solver with time windows, capacities and driver shifts, with re-optimisation when orders arrive during the day.

components.name: Driver mobile app
components.description: Flutter app with stop list, navigation hand-off, proof of delivery with photo and signature, failed delivery reasons and offline queue.

components.name: Customer tracking page and notifications
components.description: Public tracking page with live ETA from driver GPS, SMS and email notifications on departure and delivery, and rescheduling link.

components.name: Order intake API and shipper portal
components.description: REST API and CSV upload for shippers to create delivery orders, address validation and geocoding, and a portal with delivery KPIs per shipper.

components.name: Shipper invoicing
components.description: Monthly invoicing per shipper from delivered stops with tariff tables by zone and weight, credit notes for failed deliveries and export to the accounting system.
